name: Request Details 22
definition: Details of the request providing the changes and references of the instruction.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: References of the transaction for which the intra-balance modification is requested.

Linkage.name: Linkage
Linkage.definition: Specifies the type of linkage requested.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

OtherProcessing.name: Other Processing
OtherProcessing.definition: Specifies another type of processing change request.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.

ClearingChannel.name: Clearing Channel
ClearingChannel.definition: Specifies the clearing channel to be used to process the payment instruction.

ModificationRequestPresenceRule.definition: At least one modification request type element must be present.

OtherProcessingRule.definition: If OtherProcessing is used, then its usage must be pre-agreed between the sender and the receiver.
